author: Vital_Maniac
body: When should I appeal for my ban?
body_tagged: When should I appeal for my ban?
title: I'm still banned!

replies.author: Two_Become_One
replies.body:
Hello,

You were caught ban evading. That is not appealed easy. Would take a couple of months. But even then I'm not sure if you will even be able to appeal what you have done.

First you were hacking; Then you lied about it. (our evidence kicked in) Then you ban evaded.

Hopefully you can understand why we would not want to appeal that. But you can always try to appeal in a couple of months.

Regards,
Devil_Fruit, Senior Mod
